component.name: MCP Email Server
component.summary: IMAP and SMTP via MCP Server

description.p: A Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants and other MCP clients read, search, organize, and send email through IMAP and SMTP, enabling mail-account automation without a dedicated mail client.

ul.li: List, search, and read messages over IMAP
Configuration via environment variables or a local managed store
STDIO transport (also usable as an HTTP/SSE server)

description.p: Debian packaging of mcp-email-server, providing IMAP/SMTP email tools over MCP.
